evidences.description: Magnetize (HOLD) reflects damage back in a destructive cone
Crush collapses bones of nearby enemies

scores.reasoning: Mag Prime has moderate damage capabilities through its ability to reflect and redirect enemy attacks, as well as cause physical collapse. However, it lacks direct area-of-effect damage or high single-target damage potential.

evidences.description: Mag Prime has a decent shield value (455) and absorbs ranged attacks with Magnetize (HOLD)

scores.reasoning: While Mag Prime has average survivability due to its moderate shield and ability to absorb damage, it lacks defensive mechanisms like armor regeneration or energy shields.

evidences.description: Mag Prime can heal allies with Polarize

scores.reasoning: Mag Prime has limited support capabilities, primarily through healing allies with its Polarize ability. However, this is not a strong point of the Warframe.
Mag Prime has moderate crowd control through its ability to stun and ensnare enemies, but it lacks more direct or area-of-effect crowd control options.
Mag Prime does not have any stealth-related abilities or mechanics, making its stealth score low.

evidences.description: Magnetize (HOLD) requires precise timing and positioning
Crush involves aiming at specific targets

scores.reasoning: Mag Prime has a moderate level of complexity due to the need for precise timing and positioning in its abilities, particularly Magnetize (HOLD).

data.summary: Mag Prime is a balanced Warframe with moderate damage, survivability, and crowd control capabilities. It lacks strong support or stealth features but requires some skill to execute its abilities effectively.
